correctness.rationale: At every stationary state the susceptible fraction is strictly positive, and connectivity propagates any nonzero infection mass to each node, so the quantified coexistence scope is exhaustive. No symmetry assumption is needed: each leaf susceptible satisfies the identical scalar equation with strictly positive derivative. Necessary stationary identities yield explicit s_L,s_C and an invertible 2x2 system (determinant 1-b/a>0). Positivity of x_C and y_L is exactly the proposed parameter region; positive slack bounds prove s_C,s_L<1, giving a valid equilibrium. Symbolic substitution confirms all four original fixed point equations, and 25,872 rational cases including 2,208 positive ones pass full original nodewise residual and phase checks. Infinite quantifiers and strict boundary equalities are established analytically.

value.rationale: An all-size infinite family of directly motivated distinct contact topologies now has an exact complete positive-equilibrium census. Star hubs vs a universal-contact competing strain embody distinct epidemic interventions. The explicit sqrt(m)-to-quadratic-root ratio region, sharp strength threshold and center/leaf fractions allow exact prediction instead of spectral bounds or numerical solving. This is not a textbook normalizing exercise: leaf symmetry is proved globally, then nonlinear graph equations are solved and positivity classified. Stability/global basins are excluded, not falsely asserted.
